scope: named mechanism recovery, not legacy behavior/policy adoption

lessons.worked_or_useful: Provider fallback emits oauth_payload with provider tokens and can skip the Teach backend bridge.
lessons.failed_or_limited: Cutover TR-0004/0005 remove readable payload and provider fallback; credentialless provider initiation is narrower than authenticated end-to-end OAuth proof.
lessons.v2_requirement: C11/C12: one authoritative session type; provider token never a Teach session or browser storage.

lessons.worked_or_useful: Conditional transition and same-transaction append avoid best-effort audit and duplicate logout effects.
lessons.failed_or_limited: Current V2 had raw repository revocation without the connected Application audit boundary; this batch reimplements the mechanism with verifier-only storage and owner-private row locking.
lessons.v2_requirement: C12 SES-12/14/20; C23 AUD-5; real authorizer/audit adapter still absent.

lessons.worked_or_useful: Reload current actor/membership/scope; deny unknown operations before handler work.
lessons.failed_or_limited: V1 normalized authorization remains constrained by a single-location compatibility projection and older role bundles; do not import either as V2 authority.
lessons.v2_requirement: C13/C14 ordered current-fact evaluation; vocabulary/membership decisions remain unresolved.

lessons.worked_or_useful: Append through supplied transaction; prevent caller metadata from forging trusted event schema/context.
lessons.failed_or_limited: TR-0009 records fixes for unversioned event metadata and generated request IDs lost across request context.
lessons.v2_requirement: C23 same-transaction append and canonical context; no AuditEvent physical admission here.

lessons.worked_or_useful: Assignment must be rechecked and UI completion must follow accepted persistence.
lessons.failed_or_limited: Earlier learner paths could address unassigned packs and advance UI after persistence failure. V1 queued completion cannot grant V2 offline-write permission.
lessons.v2_requirement: C32 assigned-version/current-authority/atomic-start; C62 offline writes stay disabled.

lessons.worked_or_useful: Schema and pack versions are distinct; published content is immutable.
lessons.failed_or_limited: Local isolated execution accepts 01.2.3 and 1.2.3-01; these violate SemVer 2.0. This finding concerns the helper, not the whole pack pipeline.
lessons.v2_requirement: C31 OQ-CNT-1 remains proposed; use strict conformance vectors after owner selection.

lessons.worked_or_useful: Fresh replay, live read-only fingerprints, all-table browser-role denial and independent cleanup are recorded.
lessons.failed_or_limited: Do not transplant historical PASS into current V2 or assume only the directly changed tables need role isolation.
lessons.v2_requirement: C21 exact source/environment/schema/role evidence; production execution remains blocked.

lessons.worked_or_useful: Public URL/browser checks are recorded with specific limits.
lessons.failed_or_limited: A 200 public route does not prove deployed SHA or authenticated tenant flow; recorded rows explicitly retain those blockers. TR-0010 remains active in this pinned source and is not proof of completed cutover.
lessons.v2_requirement: C51/C52 exact candidate/deployment/config and authenticated negative matrix.

differences: V2 versioned verifier-only persistence replaces legacy raw token storage
Owner-private row lock yields explicit transition outcome; terminal/duplicate calls append no additional success audit
No legacy cookies, bearer fallback, role bundles, provider settings, offline writes or retention values are adopted
